blind.description: A stylized low-to-mid poly wooden sorting workbench or food preparation table. It features a sturdy timber frame with four square legs braced by horizontal stretchers. The recessed tabletop holds a heap of shiny metallic-gloss fruit, vegetables, or ore clumps on one end, a circular recessed basin with a dark grate in the center, a small square-headed mallet resting nearby, and a two-compartment wooden tray holding smaller shiny yellow and green items on the other end. Textures are warm brown wood with hand-painted stylistic grain and glossy, reflective finishes on the produce/minerals.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden tray-topped table containing a loose pile of glossy round items on the left, a round central drainage grate, a dark mallet with a wooden handle, and a partitioned rectangular wooden box filled with more round items on the right.
blind.height_vs_figure: The table stands roughly 2.5 to 2.8 feet tall (under half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and stretches about 5.5 to 6 feet in length.

match.reads_as: sorting table with ore and tools
notes: glossy clumps read somewhat ambiguously as produce or ore clumps, but context supports sorting table
